g.text: System view · recorded serving release and its upstream dependencies
Redis shown here: online-serve-jenkins-8. Earlier Docker Redis is in Layer 3.
Feast runs inside its callers. Historical lookups read Parquet through DuckDB.
System view groups related workloads; flow views expand numbered steps.
Deployment identifies actual instances, processes and disks.
Solid: data or request dependency. Dashed: orchestration, release or secret sync.
Animation shows direction, not live traffic. Crossings do not join.
